name: @seasb/metafab
description: Create, validate, install, and share software factories.

scripts.postbuild: node -e "const fs = require('node:fs'); const file = 'dist/cli.js'; const source = fs.readFileSync(file, 'utf8'); if (!source.startsWith('#!')) fs.writeFileSync(file, '#!/usr/bin/env node\n' + source); fs.chmodSync(file, 0o755);"
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
